sanskrit: te 'nyatarasmin mahatyaraṇyāyatane jvalitamiva vikasitakamalavanaśobhayā vihasadiva ca phullakumudavanairanibhṛtamadhukaragaṇamamalanīlasalilaṃ mahatsaraḥ saṃniśritya praviviktamanojñāsu cchāyādrumasamupagūḍhāsvasaṃnikṛṣṭaviniviṣṭāsu pṛthakpṛthak parṇaśālāsu vrataniyamaparā dhyānānuyuktamanaso vijahruḥ /
english: It exhibited a resplendent fiery beauty, when its lotus-beds were expanded, and offered a gay aspect, when its groups of waterlilies disclosed their calyxes; swarms of bees were always humming there. On the shore of that lake they built as many huts of leaves as they numbered, one for each, placing them at some distance from one another, hidden in the shadow of the trees in the midst of a lovely solitude. There they lived, devoted to their self-imposed vows and observances, and having their minds bound to meditation.
